title: Setup: organization 强制多因素认证 says nothing when two-factor is off, and the enrollment screen's refusal is an untranslated 404
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cbvcmv8YWFhFJwzjKL

Filing gate: ② the `domain:ui` half of #30201 (p1, whole-tenant lockout), named by its triage 6648424134 ("The Setup wording is the `domain:ui` half") and left out of the server PR #30293 by its claim. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
Reader: the Setup organization edit form and the two-factor enrollment screen (`ui/**`).
Dedupe: `require_mfa`, `强制多因素认证`, `Two-factor enable failed` → none open. **New.**

## What the server does after PR #30293

- Saving an organization with `require_mfa = true` while two-factor is off (`GET /api/v1/auth/config` → `features.twoFactor: false`) is refused: 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`, with a server message naming the reason.
- With two-factor off, the MFA gate no longer blocks anyone, so rows already stored `true` lock no one out.

## Wanted (from #30201's Expected)

- [ ] The organization form says, before saving, that requiring MFA needs two-factor enabled (Setup → Settings → Authentication), and shows the server's refusal text instead of a generic failure when the save is refused.
- [ ] When the save is accepted, say who is affected and when the block starts (the grace period, `mfa_grace_period_days`).
- [ ] The enrollment screen's refusal is localized and says what to do, instead of `Two-factor enable failed (404)`.

Links: #30201, PR #30293, #26676.
